The gem bag can be used to save inventory space when mining gem rocks that yield the uncut gems it can hold. The bag can also save inventory space when collecting gems dropped during Slayer assignments (such as goraks and abyssal demons, who drop gems frequently). Additionally, it can be used while cracking the wall safes in the Rogues' Den.
Storing gems in the bag can also save bank space. This is particularly useful for free players as they can save up to three spaces if they had all gem types in their bank. Players may only own one gem bag at a time. It should be noted that it stores 100 gems in total, not 100 gems of each type.
The gem bag can be emptied directly into a player's bank, while the bank interface is open, by right-clicking the bag in the backpack section of the bank interface, and selecting the "Empty" option. This removes the need for players to first empty the bag of gems before opening the bank interface, then bank the gems themselves manually. Doing so does not remove the gem bag from the player's inventory.

The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• cutting trees, this includes:
• crystal trees 
• elder trees
• normal bamboo and its superior version golden bamboo on the Arc
• chopping ivy
• clearing Overgrown idols
• looting Woodcutting chests in Shifting Tombs 
• capping at the Tree in a Clan Citadel
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• cutting thatch spar with a Machete
• playing a Minigame that rewards experience in this skill
• using a Divine tree

In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{T \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• T is the number of game ticks taken per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 50 is applied to this value
